result.title: Conservative Meta-Agent Search: Architecture Adaptation under Non-Stationarity
result.summary: Automated agentic-system design is typically evaluated on static task suites with immediate scalar rewards. Deployed systems face persistent shift, delayed dependent feedback, correlated component failures, and costly architecture changes. We formalize meta-agent architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and hard risk constraints and introduce Conservative Meta-Agent Search (CMAS). CMAS retrieves archived architectures and proposes typed graph edits, then scores each against the incumbent by paired shadow replay under common random numbers, with interventional component credit. Promotion requires an empirically calibrated, variance-penalized simultaneous score above a pre-specified margin, and is followed by a simulated canary stage and pre-specified rollback. Since backtests cannot certify meta-level skill, we introduce MetaInvest-Bench, a regime-switching simulator whose specified worker competence makes a surrogate-optimal architecture computable, with leakage-controlled replay, adversarial governance tracks, and five negative controls. Financial streams serve as a risk-sensitive testbed for meta-level generalization; we claim no alpha. Across 96 streams, CMAS cuts normalized mean surrogate dynamic-oracle regret from 0.116 to 0.104 and raises held-out utility from 0.44 to 0.48 over the strongest adaptive baseline; when extra workers add no value, it contracts to near-single-agent teams. Its deployment inference cost is ~6% lower, though its search-inclusive token cost is the highest of the methods compared. The observed per-update false-promotion rate is 3.4% against a nominal 5% target, and 4.8% in a sealed rerun. The calibration is empirical: it concerns an update-level replay statistic on an author-designed benchmark, and guarantees neither full-utility improvement, nor absence of simulated canary-stage harm, nor sequence-level error control.

AI.brief_summary: 该文将 meta-agent 架构搜索形式化为带切换成本与风险约束的序贯替换问题，提出 CMAS：检索归档架构、生成类型化图编辑、用配对影子回放与干预式组件信用打分，并以校准阈值晋级、模拟灰度与回滚把关，同时构建 MetaInvest-Bench 制度切换模拟器评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「干预式组件信用分配」与配对影子回放可为核查 LVR 中 latent 步骤或轨迹训练的贡献归属与验证方式提供线索，但环境为金融流上的 agent 架构搜索，与视觉推理的直接联系较弱。
